title: A Room for the Cellar
author: Theo Pemberton
blurb: Theo Quintana, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
